when: a turn that ends with reasoning only, no text and no tool call, on all of its first three tries
expect: the same session is asked again at once, up to three times, with a note telling the assistant to answer, and nothing is sent to the person meanwhile

when: a fourth empty answer after three retries
expect: the person receives a message worded as the answer taking longer than expected

when: a turn that fails with a provider error
expect: it is not tried again by the bridge and keeps the runtime's own backoff

when: a turn whose open tool call runs silently for twenty minutes, as a sub-agent revision does
expect: the turn is not killed at the silence budget and ends normally

when: a configuration reload that arrives while another reload is being applied
expect: it is applied after the first, against the configuration the first left

when: a turn queued behind a turn whose session the watchdog ends
expect: the queued turn is refused unsent

when: a Telegram adapter started with a bad token
expect: start rejects for the bad token, so the bridge reports the channel down

when: a chunk of an answer that the channel refuses
expect: the chunk is tried again after 0.5, 1 and 2 seconds and delivered when one try succeeds

when: a chunk lost after its last retry
expect: a delivery-failure marker is sent once and the rest of the answer is tried once each without the backoff

when: messages kept across a restart, one sent 31 minutes ago and one sent 29 minutes ago
expect: only the recent one is answered and the person is told once about the older one

when: a live reload that changes an agent's channel
expect: the agent's adapter is started again on the new channel

when: a live reload that changes the locale to "en"
expect: the bridge's next notice is written in the new language without restarting the adapter

when: the bridge's copy of chat-channels.json
expect: it equals every channel the bridge configures, the console's own transport aside

when: the Discord library rejects a login with the error "Used disallowed intents"
expect: the bridge classifies it as a refused credential "DisallowedIntents" of the bot token, naming the Message Content intent to enable

when: the Discord library rejects a login with the error "Authentication failed"
expect: the bridge classifies it as a refused token "AuthenticationFailed"

when: the assistant's Discord bot start is refused with "Used disallowed intents" and the supervisor schedules a retry
expect: the supervisor stops retrying, starts the bot once and records one terminal failure "DisallowedIntents"

when: the switch is turned on and the console's regeneration touches the agent file without changing its content
expect: the held agent is started again and reports ready with no failure, and a healthy agent is left alone

when: a person's turn is running and the session starts summarising its history for more than the usual silence limit
expect: the turn is not killed for silence and the chat says «Sto facendo il punto su quello che ci siamo detti finora: un paio di minuti e riprendo.»

when: a session writes its summary and stays silent past 15 minutes
expect: the turn is ended by the watchdog as silent

when: a session's newest summary marker was aborted or killed with its slot and no answer followed
expect: the session is read as stranded

when: a person's message arrives for a session holding a stranded summary marker
expect: the session summarises under a marker of its own first, then the message is sent and answered

when: a person's message arrives while the slot's server is writing a summary
expect: the bridge says it waits and sends the message once the summary is written, without summarising again

when: a person's message arrives and the summary is still unfinished after it was asked again
expect: the message is not sent and the turn fails with its notice

when: a voice message whose only text is "[Uploaded files: uploads/2026-10-10/voice-message.ogg]"
expect: the block of uploaded files is not read as the person's words and the language is "unknown"

when: the voice message arrives after an Italian turn of the same conversation
expect: the turn is tagged "lang=it", the conversation's previous language

when: a voice message arrives as the first turn after a bridge restart, with "it" as the organisation's language
expect: the turn is tagged "lang=it", the organisation's

when: the control plane answers that the instructions changed
expect: the note is the bridge's own, opens with "[instructions_result: changed]", says they changed after the conversation's last message, to follow them as they are now, and to load a skill again

when: the first message of a new conversation when the control plane gives the previous conversation's last turns
expect: the bridge adds a note of its own with the messages and what to do with them

when: the message "Sì, ho cambiato idea: preparala tu."
expect: it is tagged Italian and not French

when: short replies such as "Ok, la mando io domani." and "Va bene, mandala tu." after an Italian turn
expect: each keeps "lang=it", the conversation's language

when: an English sentence after Italian turns, and a second English one
expect: the first is tagged "lang=unknown" and the second "lang=en"

when: the instant "2026-10-13T22:30:00Z" is formatted for the zone "Europe/Rome", where it is already Wednesday after midnight
expect: the clock reads "mercoledì 2026-10-14 00:30 Europe/Rome", naming the zone's weekday and not the machine's

when: the clock is written for each day of a week in "Europe/Rome"
expect: each reads its Italian weekday name, lowercase, before the date, the time and the zone

when: the clock is written for the zone "Not/AZone" that no runtime knows
expect: the clock reads the UTC weekday, the UTC date and time, and "UTC" instead of failing the turn
